Question: Which of the following statements about sample representativeness is correct?

Choices.A: As long as the sample is randomly selected from the population and its size is appropriate, it can reflect the population reasonably well
Choices.B: The larger the sample size, the more representative the sample must be, regardless of the selection method
Choices.C: Selecting only acquaintances makes the sample more convenient and more representative

Solution: Representativeness depends on whether the selection method is random and whether the sample size is appropriate. When the sampling method is biased, even a large number of people does not necessarily make the sample representative.
